paragraphs: In [Shabbat 11a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.11a.9), the elders of Hagronia also taught in the name of Rabbi Elazar son of R' Tzadok.[^1]

notes.text: The saved William Davidson Shabbat11a paragraph supports And so the elders of Hagronia taught and the following Rabbi Elazar bar Tzadok said formula. It writes the son's full Rabbi title, while Tzadok is untitled in that local digital formula; Hyman's abbreviated paternal title remains R'. The bar relationship is preserved without binding either person to an authority record. The heading denotes the supplied collective, without importing other collectives or naming its members. No legal teaching or additional figures from the paragraph are imported. This is named digital evidence, rather than proof of printed lettering or correction history.
